content: {"rules": ["The model exhibits a persistent upward bias, consistently overestimating prices by 2-5 EUR when the underlying trend is bearish (declining history).", "Forecasts fail to capture the magnitude of mean reversion following price spikes; the model predicts a slow, linear recovery while actual prices drop sharply or remain suppressed.", "Sentiment signals (values > 0.20) are ignored by the model, which maintains a flat or slightly rising trajectory regardless of negative market sentiment or recent price drops.", "The model displays significant lag, failing to adjust forecasts downward immediately after a price drop is observed in the history, resulting in large errors in the first 5-10 days of the forecast horizon.", "In the long-term horizon (days 20-30), the model's linear projection diverges significantly from the actual volatile, lower-range trading, suggesting a need for a volatility-adjusted decay factor."]}
